title: Moving to the Package That Fits a Resident's Use — Personal Services Plan
content:
A resident of the Personal Services Plan who asks the desk to move the plan to the package that fits their use is given the lowest package whose monthly hours allotment is at least the required hours, among the packages the residence allows, so that an assisted living resident is never fitted above the Personal Services Companion Package, and where the required hours exceed every allotment an independent living resident is fitted to the Personal Services Concierge Package. The signed change takes effect on the first day of the next month when signed on or before the package's change notice cutoff day of the month, and on the first day of the month after next when signed later.

## When the package is chosen

The package that fits the resident's use is not chosen until every service order recorded in the review months as a late cancellation or a no-show carries its hours entry for that cancellation on the plan's ledger.

Put another way: while any service order recorded in the review months as a late cancellation or a no-show is without its hours entry on the plan's ledger, the package that fits the resident's use is not yet chosen.

## What the signed change shows

The change is recorded on the plan as a scheduled change: the package the plan will move to and the first day of the month from which the new package's fee and monthly hours apply. The package in effect is not altered by signing, and any change already scheduled is replaced by the new one.

| Signed on | Change takes effect |
|---|---|
| On or before the package's change notice cutoff day | First day of the next month |
| After the cutoff day | First day of the month after next |

## Invocation: `sign_services_package_change_2a41e92a`

**Capability.** The tool records a signed change of a personal services plan to another package as a scheduled change on the plan: the package the plan will move to and the first day of the month from which that package's fee and monthly hours apply. The package currently in effect is not altered by signing; any change already scheduled is replaced.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `sign_services_package_change_2a41e92a` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the resident or the resident's financial agent — runs it to sign the change.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `services_plan_id` | Reference number of the personal services plan being changed, as returned by the personal services plan lookup for this resident | Identifier |
| `target_variant_name` | The package the plan changes to | Exactly one of the values below |
| `pending_change_date` | The first day of the month from which the new package applies, local community date | `YYYY-MM-DD` with the day always 01; never empty |

Values of `target_variant_name`:

- `Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan` — paying by the hour with no monthly package;
- `Personal Services Essentials Package` — the 4-hour package;
- `Personal Services Companion Package` — the 8-hour package;
- `Personal Services Comfort Package` — the 12-hour package;
- `Personal Services Premier Package` — the 20-hour package;
- `Personal Services Concierge Package` — the 30-hour package;
- `none` — a change already scheduled is withdrawn and no new package is scheduled.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `status` set to `change_scheduled` when the change is on record, `services_plan_id` (the plan reference number), `pending_variant_name` (the package scheduled, as its full official name) and `pending_change_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, the date the change takes effect).
